args.question: Please provide the cardholder statement on the item they received and why they consider it counterfeit.

args.narrative: The item sold for 47642 USD (one capture, authorization code 973696 approved) is supported by an authenticity proof and a product description, both attached, along with the receipt for the same amount. These address the counterfeit claim under reason 13.4. The cardholder statement says they cancelled and were still charged; the merchant file holds no cancellation record, so this response does not address cancellation.

args.explanation: Seed 5010. Reason 13.4 (counterfeit), 47642 USD. Read authenticity proof, product description, receipt and authorization record, all of which I cited. Represented on 2026-03-13 with those four documents. The cardholder said they cancelled and were still charged; no cancellation record is in the file and the narrative says so. The issuer accepted the representment on 2026-03-23 and the chargeback was reversed. Ledger: chargeback 47642 debited and reversed 47642; chargeback fee 1500 charged and not reversed. Merchant balance 46142. No refund issued.
